claims.text: Das Stue sits in the heart of Berlin's embassy district.

findings.quote: Right in the heart of Berlin’s embassy district.

claims.text: The hotel is next to the Berlin Zoo and Tiergarten park.

findings.quote: with an enviable location next to the Berlin Zoo and Tiergarten park

claims.text: The hotel occupies a 1930s neoclassical stone building that was once home to the Royal Danish Embassy.

findings.quote: A grand 1930s neoclassical stone building, once home to the Royal Danish Embassy

claims.text: The high-ceilinged lobby has an original white marble staircase.

findings.quote: The high-ceilinged lobby, with its magnificent original white marble staircase

claims.text: Designer Patricia Urquiola furnished the lobby with modern furnishings of her own design and leather animals.

findings.quote: designer Patricia Urquiola has made the dramatic space cozier with comfortable modern furnishings of her own design and quirky leather animals throughout

claims.text: Photographs by Diane Arbus and Helmut Newton hang on the walls.

findings.quote: photos by celebrated shutterbugs including Diane Arbus and Helmut Newton gracing the walls

claims.text: Rooms are spread through the landmark building and a newer annex.

findings.quote: are spread throughout the landmark building and a newer annex

claims.text: Patricia Urquiola designed the room interiors, mixing modern and classic furnishings, rich fabrics and warm woods.

findings.quote: Patricia Urquiola worked her magic with the interiors, resulting in a fusion of high-end modern and classic furnishings, rich fabrics, and warm woods.

claims.text: Bathrooms have rain showers and/or freestanding bathtubs.

findings.quote: Bathrooms have rain showers and/or freestanding bathtubs

claims.text: The hotel has an indoor pool and a sauna.

findings.quote: A nice-sized indoor pool and sauna are ideal when the Berlin weather isn't cooperating.
Artful interior design, French cuisine, and a bar with character come together

claims.text: The hotel can pick guests up from Berlin Brandenburg Airport (BER).

findings.quote: We are happy to pick you up from the Berlin Brandenburg Airport - BER.

claims.text: The hotel is godparent to a kangaroo named Stuy at the Berlin Zoo.

findings.quote: Not only our godchild the kangaroo Stuy is happy about a visit but also the whole world of animals in the Berlin Zoo is worth a trip.

claims.text: Guests get exclusive access to the neighboring zoo via the bar's terrace, skipping the entrance lines but still paying for a ticket.

claims.text: Some rooms have lofty ceilings and huge windows with views of the zoo and Tiergarten.

claims.text: The public spaces display mesh sculptures of monkeys by Benedetta Mori and a crocodile head by Quentin Garel.
